capabilities: Sync the whole vault bidirectionally with a Proton Drive folder, including attachments and settings
Detect and resolve sync conflicts by keeping both copies, merging edits, or picking a side
Compare note versions side by side and restore an earlier version from Drive history
Create read-only, optionally password-protected Proton Drive share links for notes
List, pause, resume and remove the devices syncing a shared vault
extras: Marked as alpha and self-described as 'vibe-coded'; not in the community plugin store, so it must be built and installed manually or via BRAT. Depends on a pre-release Proton SDK that may break interoperability in late 2026/early 2027. Polling is capped at Proton's 30-second rate limit; the README warns the plugin can delete vault files and recommends testing on a vault copy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync through Proton Drive, an end-to-end encrypted storage service, leaving Proton users without a native sync path.

relations.evidence: built on Proton's official Drive SDK

summary: Bidirectional sync of an Obsidian vault with a Proton Drive folder, with end-to-end encryption, conflict merging, and per-note version history.
